name: La Revuelta
description: David Broncano, along with Jorge Ponce, Ricardo Castella and his other collaborators, lead La Revuelta, a comedy show that includes multiple sections and interviews from the Teatro Príncipe Gran Vía in Madrid.

videos.title: Aitor Francesena
videos.overview: ‘La Revuelta’, David Broncano's new program on RTVE, has premiered with an interview with Aitor Francesena, world champion of adapted surfing and several times champion of Spain in this discipline. Pioneer and teacher of surfers, “Gallo” lost his sight completely in 2012, but that did not stop him from continuing with his passion. In addition, the program has included the Lalachus section, which has recalled one of the most special moments, his time at the Summer Grand Prix. Jorge Ponce has presented some new features of the program in its new stage, making light of some of the controversies that have arisen.

videos.title: Najwa Nimri
videos.overview: La Revuelta has received a visit from the actress and singer Najwa Nimri, who has presented 'Respira', her new series, in which she plays the president of the Valencian Community. Valeria Ros has dedicated her section to her attempts to look younger and remain attractive, and Pablo Ibarburu has made a brief comment about the premiere of the program in its new stage. Furthermore, Jorge Ponce has exclusively announced the numbers that will not be awarded in the Bonoloto.

videos.title: Juan José Millás and Juan Luis Arsuaga
videos.overview: The writer Juan José Millás and the paleontologist Juan Luis Arsuaga have visited David Broncano in La Revuelta to present the book “Consciousness told by a sapiens to a Neanderthal”, which explains the functioning and evolution of the brain. Jorge Ponce has exercised public service for the first time by stepping on the street as a representative of public television, and Yunez Chaib, one of the program's resident comedians, has explained what the relationship is between his grandmother, who belongs to an ethnic group from North Africa, and the Argentine rapper Duki. In addition, the public has once again gained prominence with the presence of 'The councilor boy' and a pregnant woman, which have given rise to the most childish start of La Revuelta.

videos.title: Raúl Cimas
videos.overview: The fourth program of La Revuelta presented by David Broncano, featured an interview with actor and comedian Raúl Cimas, who has come to present 'El fin', an apocalyptic series. Jorge Ponce continues in his process of acclimatizing to the new stage in the public entity, and on this occasion he has taught us how to make a territorial disconnection to find out the latest news in other places in Spain. The finishing touch to a week of great audience success was provided by Antonio Resines, godfather of the format, who has just turned 70 years old and has stopped by the theater to celebrate with the public and present some gifts.

videos.title: Elisabet Casanovas, Irene Escolar, DjMariio and Sandra Carrasco
videos.overview: How much content can fit in a 70-minute program? The answer is in La Revuelta: David Broncano has interviewed the actresses Elisabet Casanovas and Irene Escolar, who present the series 'Abogadas', and the content creator DjMariio. Lalachus has shown what his parents think of the program thanks to a hidden camera, the singer Sandra Carrasco has left the entire theater speechless with her voice and Jorge Ponce has introduced us to the Alcobendas rugby team. Who gives more?

videos.title: Jhayco
videos.overview: La Revuelta has opened the list of international guests with David Broncano's interview with Puerto Rican singer Jhayco, a world star of reggaeton and urban music. Jorge Ponce has gone out into the street to show that "people are ready", Yunez Chaib has developed his theory of the "Bertinosverse" to explain the development of countries, and the public has once again been a key part of the program, with Jorge's hilarious participation from the VIP seat, the beach chair.

videos.title: Diego González Rivas
videos.overview: Surgeon Diego González Rivas, a world-renowned expert in his specialty, visited La Revuelta on Wednesday, where he spoke with David Broncano. The doctor and the presenter, one of his most illustrious patients, talked about a multitude of anecdotes from his operations in 136 countries around the world and had an emotional video call with a patient whose life he saved in Ghana. Valeria Ros took advantage of her appearance on the program to explain the only thing she likes about Japan: haikus.

videos.title: Paula Leitón
videos.overview: Paula Leitón, Olympic water polo champion in Paris 2024 and European champion in 2023 with Sabadell, has claimed in La Revuelta the diversity of bodies and the need to equalize men's and women's sport. David Broncano has once again brought out his most competitive side and challenged the Spanish national team's buoy to a one-on-one. Jorge Ponce has proposed a new question to Broncano, what to do when there are no toilet brushes in hotels? And he has presented a new game, "Death by province", in which provinces will be eliminated throughout the season until the best in Spain is chosen.

videos.title: Norman Reedus
videos.overview: Norman Reedus, star of The Walking Dead, has been the first Hollywood guest of La Revuelta. The American actor has promoted the new season of the series and has promised a cameo to David Broncano. The influencer Marina Rivers, who presents Rivers Cam on Playz, explaining her time on MasterChef Celebrity, has been the second interviewee of the day. And Jorge, the viewer who asked for a section on the programme after losing his job, has been able to fulfil his wish by explaining mathematical functions to Broncano as only he could do.

videos.title: Eduard Fernández and Israel Fernández
videos.overview: Eduard Fernández has visited La Revuelta to present his new film, ‘El 47’, in which RTVE has participated. The actor has talked with David Broncano and has reflected on how much he has learned from his daughter, the actress Greta Fernández. The singer from Toledo, Israel Fernández, who has recently published his sixth album, ‘Por amor al cante’, has been the second interviewee of the day and has launched into singing fandangos live, with Antonio “El relojero” on guitar. LalaChus has taken advantage of her section to make a complaint about the photos with which her participation in La Revuelta is being illustrated in some media.

videos.title: Danna
videos.overview: Danna's visit to La Revuelta has been a constant bombardment of pearls and headlines. The Mexican artist has confirmed to David Broncano that she had a brief relationship with the footballer Neymar, she has backed Real Madrid in Sunday's derby against Atlético, and she has confessed that the protagonist of her song 'PLATONIK' is a friend of hers who did not reciprocate her feelings. The section of the comedian Pablo Ibarburu has revolved around the number 5 and the multiple possibilities offered by its drawing, and the actor Antonio Resines, godfather of the program, has recorded the only advertisement that he will be able to sneak into this stage on RTVE.

videos.title: Merche García
videos.overview: David Broncano welcomed Merche García, two-time world MMA (mixed martial arts) champion and world grappling champion, to La Revuelta on Thursday. The Asturian fighter, who is only 16 years old, is aiming to become a great world reference in her discipline, and has conquered the programme with her naturalness and self-confidence. Jorge Ponce explained in his section the benefits of beautiful people compared to others, and the actress and comedian Silvia Abril presented her new play, ‘Las asambleístas (Las que tropiezan)’, directed by the playwright José Troncoso.

videos.title: Yolanda Ramos
videos.overview: Yolanda Ramos has starred this Monday in the most crazy and chaotic interview of this first season of La Revuelta. At the request of David Broncano, the actress has inaugurated a new format: the “interview solo”, asking and answering questions herself. The comedian Valeria Ros has explained how and why she is looking for candidates for coparenting among her friends, and the program has begun with some recommendations about Soria, a breakdance demonstration and some tricks from the professional skater Danny León, who was in the audience.

videos.title: Pou brothers, Iker and Eneko
videos.overview: The Pou brothers visited La Revuelta on Tuesday to present their next book, ‘El desafio de los cuatro elemento’ (The challenge of the four elements). Iker and Eneko, nominated for the Piolet de Oro award for mountaineering for the sixth time, told anecdotes about their expeditions and invited David Broncano to accompany them on some of them. For his part, Jorge Ponce analysed the examples used in the RAE dictionary and came to the conclusion that someone is going through a bad time. In addition, he connected with ‘Mañaneros’, the programme on La 1, to denounce the problem of squatters that they are suffering.

videos.title: Ana Mena
videos.overview: This Wednesday, David Broncano was visited on La Revuelta by singer and actress Ana Mena, who will be a judge on 'Feat', the new urban music talent show on Playz, alongside Omar Montes. Presenters Belén Esteban and María Patiño also appeared on the programme, offering Broncano a plate of judiones and commenting on his new stage in television.

videos.title: Manuel Turizo
videos.overview: David Broncano interviewed Colombian singer Manuel Turizo on Thursday, who will perform in Madrid on October 6 and presented his new song, 'Qué pecao', live with Kapo. Jorge Ponce has stepped out onto the street again and has been trolled by a passerby, and Pablo Ibarburu has explained how the process of getting over his breakup is progressing.

videos.title: Arturo Coello, Dafne Fernández and Marta Aledo
videos.overview: Arturo Coello, number 1 in the world ranking of padel at 22 years old, has visited La Revuelta this Monday, reviewing his career and his latest titles with David Broncano. Marta Aledo and Dafne Fernández, protagonists of 4 estrellas, have also been on the program to promote the final outcome of the series, which can be followed on RTVE Play. Jorge Ponce has continued analyzing examples that show that someone in the RAE is not going through their best moment.

videos.title: Hovik Keuchkerian and Milena Smit
videos.overview: Actors Hovik Keuchkerian and Milena Smit visited David Broncano on Tuesday to present their new film, ‘El hoyo 2’, in La Revuelta as well as to recite poems and articles from the Constitution. In her section, Lalachus has asked to be included in the Telepasión gala, and has organised a test performing a song from ‘Beauty and the Beast’ with Broncano.

videos.title: Cristóbal Colón and Regis Francisco González, Jordi Mollà and Lapili
videos.overview: Christopher Columbus, a direct descendant of the navigator who arrived in America, and the journalist Regis Francisco González, presented the documentary 'Colón ADN, su verdadero origen' on La Revuelta de David Broncano, which premieres on October 12 on La 1. Jordi Mollà presented his new book, 'Tú', and Yúnez Chaib spoke about the mysterious country of Jovenlandia. In addition, the program included a musical performance by Lapili.

videos.title: Berto Romero and Andreu Buenafuente
videos.overview: Comedian Berto Romero visited La Revuelta on Thursday to settle his outstanding scores with David Broncano. One of them was to play a game of Words, which required the presence of Andreu Buenafuente on the show. In his section, Jorge Ponce showed previously unpublished photos of Juan Carlos I to which only he had access.

videos.title: Paz Vega
videos.overview: Actress Paz Vega presented her first film as a director, 'Rita', on Monday at David Broncano's La Revuelta. Lalachus has once again drawn on nostalgia to bring together the legendary Sonia and Selena on stage for the first time in 23 years. In addition, the programme has received a message from Shakira and has connected with the Altamira cave.

videos.title: Julio Maldonado 'Maldini' and Alejandro Montalvo
videos.overview: David Broncano has interviewed sports journalist Julio Maldonado, better known as Maldini, and the 2023 world trial champion, Alejandro Montalvo, on La Revuelta, who has put on a spectacular display of his skills. The programme also included sections by Pablo Ibarburu and Jorge Ponce, and we have discovered what the Magic Man does when he is not recording his message for children.

videos.title: Marc Cucurella and Rita Payés
videos.overview: Footballer Marc Cucurella, a player for Chelsea and the Spanish national team, visited David Broncano's La Revuelta on Wednesday, and singer and trombonist Rita Payés put the finishing touch with a live musical performance. The programme also included sections by Jorge Ponce and Valeria Ros.

videos.title: María Galiana and Las Ninyas del Corro
videos.overview: This Thursday, David Broncano was visited at La Revuelta by actress María Galiana, Herminia from Cuéntame, who was presenting her new film, 'Sociedad Negra'. In addition, he met surgeon Diego González Rivas, who saved the life of another patient thanks to The Revolt. And the musical closing was provided by Las Ninyas del Corro, rapping the song 'The Wave' from their album 'Bitches in Business'.

videos.title: Andrés Pajares and Lorena Nogal
videos.overview: Actor and comedian Andrés Pajares visited David Broncano at La Revuelta on Monday to present his book “Mis memorias… antes de que se me olviden” and to review his extensive career. The dancer Lorena Nogal, winner of the National Dance Award, gave a demonstration on stage and the programme also included a connection with the Doñana National Park.

videos.title: Sonya Yoncheva
videos.overview: Sonya Yoncheva, the Bulgarian soprano who will star in Purcell's opera Dido and Aeneas at the National Auditorium in Madrid and Oviedo this October, was the guest this Tuesday on David Broncano's La Revuelta. In addition, the programme included a section by Yunez Chaib, and she issued an authorisation for some university students to be absent from class, and a certificate of disability.

videos.title: Ester Expósito and Dani Fernández
videos.overview: Actress Ester Expósito presented her next film, 'El llanto', on David Broncano's La Revuelta, alongside her co-stars, Mathilde Ollivier and Malena Villa. The actress also explained how she prefers to carry out her flirtations and expressed her wish that Danna had fallen in love with her. Singer Dani Fernández closed the programme with a musical performance, and confessed how his life has changed as a result of fatherhood.

videos.title: Bad Gyal and Juan Enrique Soto
videos.overview: Catalan artist Bad Gyal has visited La Revuelta by David Broncano to present her documentary film La Joia, in which she shows what her team's day-to-day life has been like around the launch of her latest album. Police inspector and populariser Juan Enrique Soto Castro, creator of the Conduct Analysis Section, has presented the new RTVE Play documentary series 'SAC: En la mente criminal', which premieres on 30 October. In addition, the programme has included sections by Jorge Ponce and Pantomima Full.

videos.title: Carolina Marín and Emilio Gavira
videos.overview: Badminton player Carolina Marín, Olympic champion in Rio 2016, three-time world champion and winner of the Princess of Asturias Award for Sport in 2024, was the guest interviewed today by David Broncano on La Revuelta. In addition, actor Emilio Gavira visited the programme to make a claim in defence of the dignity of people with achondroplasia. Jorge Ponce said in his section that children already include him in the drawings on the programme.

videos.title: Antonio Díaz "El Mago Pop" and Chloe DelaRosa
videos.overview: This Tuesday, October 29, David Broncano interviewed Catalan illusionist Antonio Díaz, known as El Mago Pop, on La Revuelta, who has broken the Guinness record for the highest-grossing one-man show on Broadway, surpassing Hugh Jackman. In addition, The Revolt received a visit from Chloe DelaRosa, the 9-year-old singer who will represent Spain at the Junior Eurovision Song Contest 2024, which will be held in Madrid on November 16. Jorge Ponce offered solutions in his section in search of social consensus, and Yunez Chaib reflected on race as a social construct.

videos.title: Miquel Montoro, Luisa Mayol, Luis Tosar and La María
videos.overview: Mallorcan Miquel Montoro, creator of rural content who rose to fame with the video "Hostia pilotes", visited La Revuelta de David Broncano this Monday. Actors Luisa Mayol and Luis Tosar, a couple in real life, presented their new film "Amanece en Samaná", and Valencian singer La Maria closed the programme by performing her song 'Mon Vetlatori', in tribute to the victims of the DANA.

videos.title: Anne Igartiburu
videos.overview: Anne Igartiburu, a legendary RTVE presenter with a career spanning almost three decades in the public broadcaster, was interviewed this Tuesday by David Broncano on La Revuelta, the first RTVE guest to appear on the programme. The programme also contacted surgeon Diego González Rivas, a specialist in minimally invasive heart and lung surgery, who is currently operating in Shanghai. Jorge Ponce has taken to the streets to hold a competition in which he has engaged several celebrities to make donations to those affected by DANA.

videos.title: Iñaki and Nico Williams
videos.overview: Iñaki and Nico Williams, brothers, footballers and teammates at Athletic Club de Bilbao, were interviewed this Wednesday on David Broncano's La Revuelta. The programme also included the first appearance of Ernesto Sevilla, who is looking into new options for his career, and the singer from Cadiz, Judeline, put the finishing touch with a musical performance, presenting her new album 'Bodhiria'.

videos.title: Mario Casas and mexian singer Carín León
videos.overview: David Broncano received a visit on Thursday from actor Mario Casas, who presented his new film, 'Escape', directed by Rodrigo Cortés. Mexican singer Carín León also visited La Revuelta, closing the programme with a musical performance. Jorge Ponce explained in his section some useful uses of mnemonic rules.

videos.title: Juan Gómez Jurado, Pito Camacho and Kiko Matamoros
videos.overview: This Monday, La Revuelta received visits from the writer Juan Gómez Jurado, who is presenting his new book, 'Todo muere'. In addition, David Broncano has interviewed the footballer Antonio 'Pito' Camacho, a player for Zamora CF in the 1st RFEF. Finally, the commentator and television collaborator Kiko Matamoros has appeared on the programme to collect his outstanding debts.

videos.title: David Bustamante
videos.overview: David Bustamante was the guest this Tuesday on La Revuelta de David Broncano, where he presented his eleventh album, entitled "Inédito", the first of his career in which he has composed the lyrics and music for all the songs. The Cantabrian artist invited him to become the second 'Sorropotunero Mayor' of San Vicente de la Barquera and mediated in the beef with Pitingo. In addition, Jorge Ponce explained on the programme how some of the usual tricks of television work.

videos.title: María José López Galiano y Marcos de la Peña, and Adriana Torrebejano
videos.overview: La Revuelta has received a visit from the biologist María José López Galiano and the chemist Marcos de la Peña, members of the international team that has discovered the biological entity they have called 'Obelisk'. The actress Adriana Torrebejano has also visited David Broncano to talk about her latest projects and, above all, have a snack. And the comedian Lalachus wanted to remove the "smell of eggs" from the program that it had acquired in recent days and, in the process, make a request to the presenter.

videos.title: Malcolm Treviño-Sitté and Aymar Navarro
videos.overview: This Thursday, La Revuelta received a visit from actor Malcolm Treviño-Sitté, star of the new RTVE series 'Detective Touré'. David Broncano has also interviewed Aranese skier Aymar Navarro, a reference and pioneer of freeride in Spain, who has presented his latest two projects. The comedian Jorge Ponce has explained that he has a lot of accumulated fatigue due to his insomnia and his two daughters, and has carried out an escapism trick.

videos.title: Carmen Machi
videos.overview: On Monday, La Revuelta received a visit from actress Carmen Machi, who was interviewed for the first time by David Broncano. A regular follower of the programme, the actress sent an emotional message to tennis player Rafa Nadal, recreated the birth of a cow and read article 47 of the Constitution. Jorge Ponce explained how the term POV (Point of view) should be used, and Yunez Chaib spoke about musical groups that have seen changes in their line-ups.

videos.title: Lucía Martín-Portugués, Araceli Navarro, Celia Pérez and Elena Hernández, and Miguel Ángel Muñoz
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews the fencers of the Spanish fencing team in the sabre discipline Lucía Martín-Portugués, Araceli Navarro, Elena Hernández and Celia Pérez, individual European champion in 2024. La Revuelta has also received a visit from the actor and presenter Miguel Ángel Muñoz, one of the protagonists of La Moderna, a RTVE series nominated for the International Emmy Awards. Lalachus has told the ins and outs of the Ondas gala and Broncano has spoken again with Karla Zambrano, a spectator who brought her thesis to the program and turned out to be an international expert on climate change.

videos.title: María Becerra and Ana Moura
videos.overview: David Broncano was visited at La Revuelta by the Argentine artist María Becerra, who presented her latest single, 'Sexo es moda'. In addition, the singer nicknamed 'La nena de Argentina' revealed some details about her private life, such as how much time she spends on her mobile phone every day, how she calls her boyfriend in private or what whim she is going to include in her new house. The Portuguese fado singer Ana Moura also presented her new song, 'Desliza', with which she dissociates female eroticism from pornography and the impositions of the patriarchy.

videos.title: The deer's bellow
videos.overview: David Broncano explained this Thursday, November 21st on La Revuelta that the program was unable to interview Moto GP world champion Jorge Martín due to external pressure from El Hormiguero. The program also included a section by Jorge Ponce, who installed the first roundabout on Gran Vía, and Pablo Ibarburu, who updated his recovery process after his breakup.

videos.title: Rigoberta Bandini and Raúl Cimas
videos.overview: The singer Rigoberta Bandini has visited La Revuelta to present her new song and video clip, Pamela Anderson, and announce her return to the tour after two years away from the stage. David Broncano has also received a visit from comedian Raúl Cimas, honored as the program's most frequent wild card guest. Jorge Ponce has once again analyzed the new trends of the internet and social networks in his section.

videos.title: Hugo Silva and Biznaga
videos.overview: This Tuesday, November 26, La Revuelta received a visit from actor Hugo Silva, who presented his new film, 'Desmontando a Lucía', and answered David Broncano's Classic Questions for the first time. The punk rock band Biznaga has put the musical closing, with a claim about the housing problem in Spain, Lalachus has anticipated the letter of the Three Wise Men by presenting the toys of the program.

videos.title: Mina El Hammani and Laura Escanes
videos.overview: The actress Mina El Hammani has presented her first film as a protagonist in La Revuelta, Raqa, participated by RTVE. The influencer Laura Escanes has also visited David Broncano to promote the fourth season of her podcast. Jorge Ponce has demonstrated the risks of not investing in science with a live operation, and Zorrorífico Foxer and Detective Murciano have returned to the program, ascending from the bidet to the royal thrones.

videos.title: Jorge Martín and Ca7riel and Paco Amoroso
videos.overview: Jorge Martín, MotoGP world champion rider, has finally visited, after several days of controversy, La Revuelta by David Broncano, which also featured an interview and musical performance by Argentine artists Ca7riel and Paco Amoroso. The comic duo Pantomima Full has presented their new attitude in The Revolt now that they are star actors, and Pablo Ibarburu has taken another step in his recovery after their breakup, arranging a visit to the Juan y Medio program.

videos.title: Dani Martín
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews Dani Martín, who presented his new album at La Revuelta, "The last day of our lives". The Madrid singer, former leader of El Canto del Loco, has sold more than 160,000 tickets on his tour for the year 2025 and only has concerts available from 2026. Jorge Ponce has been in charge of inaugurating the new addition to the program, the tube from Lamson, a device that allows objects to be moved at high speed from Broncano's table to Miguel Campos' table thanks to pneumatic pressure.

videos.title: Lola Índigo, Sara Sálamo and Cirque du Soleil
videos.overview: The singer Lola Índigo visited La Revuelta to present her new single, 'Perreíto pa' llorar', and to talk about the current situation of her tour, with the concert at the Santiago Bernabéu still to be confirmed. David Broncano also interviewed the actress Sara Sálamo, who is presenting her new film, 'Al otro barrio', and the programme included a section by Lalachus and a music and contortion show by Cirque du Soleil.

videos.title: Rels B, Gabriela Andrada and Megan Maxwell
videos.overview: The Mallorcan singer Rels B, the most listened to Spanish artist in the world, has announced his new song, 'Te regalo', on La Revuelta, and has officially confirmed that he is going to marry his girlfriend, the Colombian content creator Nicole Betancur. David Broncano has also interviewed the actress Gabriela Andrada, star of the film 'Pídeme lo que quieres', based on the novel of the same name by the writer Megan Maxwell, who has also been present on the programme. In addition, Yunez Chaib has presented the ATP Awards, the A Tu País awards for the most racist moments of the year, and two icons of the programme have reappeared, Detective Murciano and Foxer Zorrorífico.

videos.title: Álex de la Iglesia and Inés Hernand
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews film director Álex de la Iglesia for the first time on La Revuelta, who is premiering a new series, '1992', about a crime related to the Expo'92 in Seville. Inés Hernand, a lawyer, presenter and internet personality, visits the programme after being crowned champion of the ninth edition of Masterchef Celebrity. In addition, Jorge Ponce continues to seek new social consensus, and a spectator paints a picture during the recording of the programme.

videos.title: Clara Galle
videos.overview: Clara Galle is one of the guests that David Broncano has interviewed the most times, and she always outdoes herself. In her fifth visit, the first in the new phase of The Revolt, the 22-year-old actress has presented the new season of the series 'The Head', has given a multitude of gifts to David Broncano and has made an improvised tattoo live. Valeria Ros has spoken in her section about motherhood and the complications of reconciling, and Jorge Ponce has been in charge of presenting one of the new features of the program.

videos.title: José Carlos Ibarra and Ana Belén
videos.overview: David Broncano welcomes the singer and actress Ana Belén to La Revuelta, who is preparing a new album after more than 60 years of professional career. The chess player José Carlos Ibarra, Spanish champion in the blitz discipline in 2023, has visited the program and played a game with the presenter. In addition, Jorge Ponce has started Christmas by going out on the street to encourage people to accompany him for a walk around Madrid.

videos.title: Manuel Carrasco
videos.overview: The singer Manuel Carrasco has commented on La Revuelta about the fines received for his concert at the Santiago Bernabéu, has promised tickets for the concert in Seville and has thrilled the public by performing his song "Mujer de las mil batallas" live. Lalachus, who will ring the bells on RTVE with David Broncano, has shut mouths in the face of the criticism and mockery received in recent days, and Antonio Resines has appeared to promote his new film, 'Un lío de millones'.

videos.title: Luis Figo
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews former Portuguese footballer Luís Figo, who played for Real Madrid and Barcelona, ​​and visits La Revuelta to present the Leyendas vs. Streamers match, alongside content creator Spursito. Broncano has contacted surgeon Diego González Rivas again from Azerbaijan, and Jorge Ponce has tried to dispel the hoax spread by the presenter related to the Korean heart.

videos.title: Pablo Álvarez and Karla Sofía Gascón
videos.overview: Pablo Álvarez from León, the only Spanish astronaut from the European Space Agency, visits La Revueltat to explain some details about his preparation for the next space mission. David Broncano also interviews actress Karla Sofía Gascón, winner of the award for best actress at the 2024 European Film Awards and nominated for the Golden Globes for her participation in the film 'Emilia Pérez'. And, taking advantage of the fact that Broncano and Lalachus will ring the 2025 New Year's Eve chimes on RTVE, Jorge Ponce points out a historical mistake we make when eating the grapes.

videos.title: Nathy Peluso
videos.overview: The Argentine artist Nathy Peluso visits La Revuelta de David Broncano to promote her new album, 'GRASA', whose tour in Spain will be announced soon, and to celebrate Christmas with a live Christmas carol. The programme connects via video call with the Basque mountaineer Álex Txakon, in the middle of acclimatisation in the Himalayas to attempt the winter ascent of Annapurna. Pablo Ibarburu tries to deceive the production team but it backfires and Jorge Ponce threatens the audience at knifepoint.

videos.title: Duki and Dabiz Muñoz
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews Argentine rapper Duki on La Revuelta, who announces the dates of his tour in Spain for the month of October 2025. Dabiz Muñoz, three times named best chef in the world, is the second guest on the programme, presenting his new documentary 'UniverXO Dabiz'. Lalachus is already preparing to ring in the 2025 New Year's Eve chimes on RTVE alongside Broncano and has asked for help from someone with knowledge in the matter: Belén Esteban.

videos.title: Gerard Piqué, Amaia and Silvia Alonso
videos.overview: La Revuelta bids farewell to 2024 with a programme packed with guests. Former footballer Gerard Piqué returns to visit David Broncano to present the Kings World Cup Nations 2025, the Kings format world cup for national teams, which he owns. Actress Silvia Alonso has briefly appeared to promote her new film, 'Sin instrucciones', and singer Amaia presents her new album, 'Si abro los ojos no es real', with a spectacular staging of her song "Tengo un pensamiento".

videos.title: Belén Esteban
videos.overview: Belén Esteban predicted a victory for David Broncano and Lalachus in the ratings for the 2025 New Year's Eve Chimes with RTVE, and asked for a special programme for her if her prediction came true, and so it has been. The popular commentator has presented the first programme of the year 2025 of La Revuelta, which also included a section by Jorge Ponce.

videos.title: Pedro Alonso
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews actor Pedro Alonso in La Revuelta, who makes his debut as a creator and director with the documentary 'En la nave del Encanto'. A project in which he narrates his travels through Mexico, learning about the country's ancestral traditional medicine and his experiences with shamanic rituals. Broncano also talks via video call with Alex Txikon, the Basque mountaineer who attempted the winter ascent of Annapurna, who had to undergo emergency surgery in Kathmandu.

videos.title: Kira Miró and Carolina Durante
videos.overview: La Revuelta receives a visit from the Canarian actress Kira Miró, who presents the third season of the series Machos Alfa. David Broncano also interviews the indie band Carolina Durante, who perform their song "Hamburguesas" live. Jorge Ponce tries to give a comical twist to scams with voices generated by artificial intelligence and we meet Guillermo Martínez, creator of prosthetics with 3D printers.

videos.title: Noah Higón and Coque Malla
videos.overview: Noah Higón, a lawyer, political scientist and activist who promotes investment in research and science, visits La Revuelta de David Broncano to explain what his life is like with seven rare diseases. The singer and actor Coque Malla, who was the leader of Los Ronaldos, also visits the programme to present his 40th anniversary tour and sing live "¡Volverá?", together with Dani Martín and Rulo.

videos.title: C. Tangana and Yerai Cortés
videos.overview: La Revuelta is visited by artists C. Tangana and Yerai Cortés, who present the documentary 'La guitarra flamenca de Yerai Cortés' together with David Broncano, with which Pucho has made his debut as a film director. In addition, the flamenco guitarist has closed the programme with a musical performance accompanied by a female choir. Jorge Ponce goes out into the street to check people's language level and Valeria Ros talks about her experience with the Montessori method.

videos.title: Juan Floristán and Vicky López
videos.overview: La Revuelta welcomes the visit of the Sevillian pianist Juan Floristán, winner of the first prize at the Arthur Rubinstein International Piano Competition in 2021, and David Broncano also interviews the 18-year-old footballer Vicky López, who plays for FC Barcelona and the Spanish national team. Jorce Ponce presents his own Lottery draw and Yunez Chaib teaches how to pronounce his name correctly.

videos.title: Fernando Arrabal and Carolina Yuste
videos.overview: Fernando Arrabal is one of the most performed Spanish playwrights in the world and, at 92 years old, he continues to publish books and has visited La Revuelta for the first time. David Broncano also interviews actress Carolina Yuste, nominated for two Goya awards: best leading actress for 'La infiltrada' and best documentary short for 'Ciao bambina'. Pablo Ibarburu prepares to travel to Miami and Jorge Ponce has problems with the team again due to the Lottery draw.

videos.title: Joan Pradells and Fariba Sheikhan
videos.overview: Professional bodybuilder Joan Pradells (Valencia, 1996) visits La Revuelta to do his physical check-up every season with David Broncano. In addition, Broncano interviews actress Fariba Sheikhan (Guernica, 1988), who presents her new film, 'Adiós Madrid'. Jorge Ponce reviews some of the milestones left by the American president Donald Trump in recent years and shows a compilation of the best moments from the RTVE Play editorial team.

videos.title: Arturo Valls and Tosha Schareina
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews Valencian driver Tosha Schareina, who has just achieved second place in the 2025 Dakar Rally, on the verge of being proclaimed champion. Actor, presenter and comedian Arturo Valls, nominated for a Goya as producer for the short fiction film 'El trono', has briefly passed through La Revuelta. In addition, Lalachus has introduced The Bananna Twins and Pablo Ibarburu has connected from Miami, where he is on the occasion of the Rose d'Or Latin television awards.

videos.title: Dani Rovira and Marián Mouriño
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews actor and comedian Dani Rovira, who presents his new show, 'Vale la pena', in which he makes comedy out of the complicated situations he has experienced in recent years. The only Spanish president of a first division football club, Marián Mouriño, visits La Revuelta to make a very special announcement about Celta de Vigo's next match. And Pablo Ibarburu connects from Miami to comment on how things went at the Rose d'Or Latin television awards.

videos.title: Mirela Balic and Nayanesh Ayman
videos.overview: The actress of Serbian-Croatian origin Mirela Balic visits La Revuelta for the first time to promote her new film, 'Mala influencia', and to turn David Broncano into a tough guy. The double world champion and first Spanish muay thai medallist Nayanesh Ayman tells the reasons why he started fighting after a difficult childhood. Jorge Ponce continues with his tradition of rhyming gifts and presents two very special ones: the one from Felipe VI and the one from Chelo García Cortés.

videos.title: Alejandro Sanz and Sara García
videos.overview: Madrid-based artist Alejandro Sanz visits La Revuelta to present his new song, 'Hoy no me sentir bien', alongside Mexicans Grupo Frontera, and to offer to mediate in the tensions between Pablo Motos and David Broncano. In addition, Sara García, the first Spanish astronaut in history, explains in the programme the details of her training in the European Space Agency reserve. Jorge Ponce reviews some headlines on climate change to dismantle denialist theories.

videos.title: Almudena Ariz
videos.overview: Journalist Almudena Ariza is one of the most recognisable and respected reporters in the field, with a long career at RTVE in which she has covered conflicts and catastrophes on all continents. The day before her return to Jerusalem to continue reporting on the conflict between Israel and Palestine, she visits David Broncano's La Revuelta to share anecdotes about her career.

videos.title: Nia
videos.overview: La Revuelta receives a visit from NIA, the winning singer of Operación Triunfo 2020, who will represent Spain at the Viña del Mar International Song Festival, held in Chile. David Broncano also connects by video call to surgeon Diego González Rivas, directly from an operating room in Mexico. Pantomima Full return to the program to announce a change of direction in their lives.

videos.title: Quevedo
videos.overview: This Thursday, La Revuelta received a visit from the Canarian Quevedo, who is presenting his second album, 'Buenas noches', and has talked to David Broncano about details of his life, such as the fact that he still lives with his parents or that he recently got his driving license in Cuenca. Antonio Resines has also appeared on the programme to promote his new film, 'Mikaela', and to once again vindicate the sobaos pasiegos.

videos.title: Melody
videos.overview: La Revuelta kicks off the month of February by welcoming the artist of the moment. David Broncano interviews Melody, the brand new winner of the Benidorm Fest 2025, who will represent Spain at the Eurovision contest in May in Basel, Switzerland. The presenter and the singer have agreed on a change of choreography in homage to the programme. Lalachus, who has also been in Benidorm, has arrived delighted with the Alicante city. And the programme has welcomed one of its most illustrious spectators, Detective Murciano.

videos.title: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón
videos.overview: Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, winner of the 2025 Goya Honor, visits La Revuelta. David Broncano interviews the youngest actress to receive the honorary award, who also presents the film 'Tierra baja'. Jorge Ponce develops the multiverse of possible futures that open up without the Lottery due to the change in broadcast time and Yunez Chaib explains the theory of the great replacement.

videos.title: Liana Romero Swirski
videos.overview: Liana Romero, known as "the youngest Spanish spy of World War II", visits La Revuelta to talk about her experiences with her mother, Larissa Swirski, a spy who worked as a double agent between the Germans and the British, known as the "Queen of Hearts". David Broncano also talks with Eduard Pérez Piqué, captain of communications for the Army, from the Spanish military base in Antarctica, as he promised during his visit to the programme. In addition, Jorge Ponce intends to raise the cultural level of the programme with a very high-level section.

videos.title: Amaral
videos.overview: La Revuelta welcomed Eva Amaral and Juan Aguirre, members of Amaral, who presented their ninth album, 'Dolce vita', alongside David Broncano. In addition, accompanied by their band, they performed the song that gives the album its title live for the theatre audience. Pablo Ibarburu has returned from Miami to tell how he lived the experience, taking advantage of the opportunity to record a series.

videos.title: Salva Reina and la Selección Española de Rugby
videos.overview: The actor from Malaga, Salva Reina, visits La Revuelta as the winner of the 2025 Goya Award for Best Supporting Actor for his role in 'El 47'. David Broncano also interviews Mario Pichardie, Álvaro García, Imanol Urraza and Gonzalo Vinuesa, players from the Spanish men's team that has qualified for the second time in its history for the 2027 Rugby World Cup in Australia. Jorge Ponce reflects on irony and reinterprets one of the most viral videos of today. Montoya!

videos.title: Leonor Watling and Javier Gutiérrez
videos.overview: Actor Javier Gutiérrez and actress and singer Leonor Watling, although late in their case, are visiting La Revuelta to present their new series, 'La vida breve', a historical comedy, alongside David Broncano. Lalachus has reviewed the "messiness" that exists in some television programmes and has analysed some of the ins and outs of the Goya awards.

videos.title: José Mota and Tiago PZK
videos.overview: José Mota returns to RTVE with a new programme, 'José Mota No News', alongside Patricia Conde, Santiago Segura and Florentino Fernández, and has been on La Revuelta to present it. In addition, David Broncano interviews the Argentine artist Tiago PZK, now known as Gotti, who has announced the release of his next album. Valeria Ros has revealed that she has a new boyfriend and that she has been diagnosed as PAS (Highly Sensitive Person).

videos.title: Kílian Jornet and Cupido
videos.overview: The high mountain runner and skier Kílian Jornet exceptionally leaves his natural environment to visit David Broncano in La Revuelta, with whom he has recalled some anecdotes of his most extreme adventures, such as suffering hallucinations or falling asleep on his bike.

videos.title: Jordi Roca and Pablo Sainz-Villegas
videos.overview: Jordi Roca, pastry chef at Celler de Can Roca and Rocambolesc, among others, is considered one of the best in the world in his profession and visits La Revuelta to present his new book, 'La nevera medio llena'. In addition, David Broncano interviews the musician Pablo Sainz-Villegas, considered the master and ambassador of the Spanish guitar in the world, who closes the program musically by performing 'Gran jota de concierto' live. Pablo Ibarburu is much better after his breakup and, to convince Broncano of this, he lists things that make him happy.

videos.title: Anna Castillo
videos.overview: Actress Anna Castillo, winner of a Goya for best new actress for 'El Olivo', presents her new series, 'Su majestad', at La Revuelta. During her interview with David Broncano, the actress has pointed out the importance of "being able to laugh at the country we have."

videos.title: Aitana
videos.overview: La Revuelta receives a visit from Aitana, one of the biggest stars of Spanish music. In her interview with David Broncano, with whom she maintains a friendship, the artist has presented her new documentary 'Aitana: Metamorfosis', in which she shows her daily life over the last year.

videos.title: Pedro Acosta and Los Delinqüentes
videos.overview: Motorcycle racer Pedro Acosta begins the new MotoGP season as an official Red Bull KTM rider and visits David Broncano to talk about how he faces his career and his life, at 20 years old. Los Delinqüentes visit La Revuelta to announce their return and reunite for the first time in 13 years on stage, with an appearance by the late Migue Benítez.

videos.title: Fernado Tejero
videos.overview: La Revuelta receives a visit from actor Fernando Tejero, who has just announced his departure from the series 'La que se avecina' and presents his new play, 'Camino al zoo'. The actor from Cordoba also takes advantage of the opportunity to seal his reconciliation with David Broncano, after a failed first interview.

videos.title: Leanna García and Ratones Paranoicos
videos.overview: David Broncano interviews Leanna García, the first Spanish woman to compete in monobob, the individual modality of bobsleigh, and who hopes to participate in the Winter Olympics in Milan-Cortina in 2026. In addition, La Revuelta welcomes the legendary Argentine rock and roll band Ratones Paranoicos, who are on tour in Spain and have closed the programme with a live performance. The comedian Yunez Chaib has explained some examples of generational gaps that he has observed, for example, with his sisters.

videos.title: Chris Pratt
videos.overview: David Broncano has once again welcomed a Hollywood guest, actor Chris Pratt, who has said that 'La Revuelta' has been the best interview programme he has ever been on. The American actor, one of the highest paid in the industry, is releasing his new film, 'Estado Eléctrico', on 14 March. In addition, Noah Higón has returned to the programme to present his documentary 'Noah', which will be released on 28 February on RTVE Play.
